direction.camera: Guide attention with kinetic headline; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: stage a short headline as a succession of large words; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with word ladder; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with readable pause.
direction.lighting: punchy graphic key; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: printed blocks and sharp typographic edges; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around sharp arrival; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use kinetic headline,word ladder,staggered rhythm,high contrast,sharp arrival,readable pause as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
